heroHeadline: Saudi Arabia Officially Confirms Two Airports Struck by Houthis
heroSubtitle: Saudi Arabia made an official acknowledgement that two of its airports were struck by Houthi forces, corroborating earlier Houthi claims of the attacks. Coalition air operations against Houthi targets in Yemen continue as government forces press offensives toward Sanaa and along the Red Sea coast.
footerNote: Data sourced from Saudi Press Agency, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Washington Post, Bloomberg, NBC News, CNN, NPR, ABC News (Australia), TASS, Türkiye Today, Anadolu Agency, News.Az, Yemen Monitor, Arab News, UN OCHA, UN News, World Health Organization, Security Council Report, CFR Global Conflict Tracker, Trading Economics, and the US Senate Armed Services Committee record. Contested claims flagged with opposing perspectives.
